description: Source code for protectConfig.c, a set of functions implementing encryption and decryption of configuration data using mbedtls, including session management, version control, and base64 encoding/decoding.

methods.name: extractParts
methods.description: Parses a base64-encoded encrypted message into its version, IV, and data parts.

methods.name: isReady
methods.description: Checks if the encryption session is initialized and ready.

methods.name: openProtectConfigSession
methods.description: Initializes cryptographic contexts and starts a session for encryption/decryption.

methods.name: closeProtectConfigSession
methods.description: Releases cryptographic resources and ends the session.

methods.name: forceProtectVersion
methods.description: Sets the encryption version to be used, allowing explicit control over encryption mode.

methods.name: protectConfigData
methods.description: Encrypts and base64-encodes configuration data using a provided password.

methods.name: unprotectConfigData
methods.description: Decodes and decrypts configuration data using a provided password.

methods.name: generateProtectPassword
methods.description: Generates a random encryption key for protecting configuration data.

methods.name: protectedConfigGenerateBytes
methods.description: Creates a random byte array of specified length for cryptographic use.

methods.name: destroyProtectConfigData
methods.description: Zeroizes and frees a pcData structure containing sensitive data.
